name: Tubular
description: Tubular MCP connects Claude to Tubular's social video intelligence. Ask in plain language to search videos and creators across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, pull trends over time, and see audience demographics and overlap — powered by Tubular's Public API v4. Read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tubular to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tubular to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tubularlabs.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tubular MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tubular provides these MCP tools: execute, get_schema, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tubular?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tubular in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Tubular requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tubular is developed by Tubular Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
